newsitem.title: UK: One Brent cargo "clocked", the other kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent cargo "clocked", the other kept - trade.

text.p: One of two Brent cargoes turning wet on Monday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline while the other went unclaimed, traders said.
Finnish refiner Neste kept a cargo loading Nov 19-21. The other cargo, with the same dates, was clocked to Shell UK, they added.
Traders reported two wet Brent deals, the first at Dec Brent -42 cents for a Nov 13-15 cargo and the second at Dec Brent -35 cents for a Nov 15-17 loader.
